objects.description: Enumeration selecting the client handle type: producer or consumer. Used with rd_kafka_new() and rd_kafka_type().
Enumeration describing what a message timestamp represents (unavailable, create time, or broker log-append time).
Opaque client instance handle representing a Kafka producer or consumer. Forward-declared here; constructed via rd_kafka_new().
Opaque topic handle associated with an rd_kafka_t instance. Created with rd_kafka_topic_new().
Opaque global configuration object. Create and populate with rd_kafka_conf_new() and rd_kafka_conf_set(), pass to rd_kafka_new().
Opaque topic-level configuration object. Create with rd_kafka_topic_conf_new(), set properties, and pass to rd_kafka_topic_new() or set as default on a global conf.
Opaque event/message queue handle used for polling, forwarding, background processing, and SASL/OAUTH events.
Opaque event object returned from rd_kafka_queue_poll() carrying different types (DR, FETCH, ERROR, ADMIN results, etc.).
Opaque per-topic operation result container used by Admin API results (CreateTopics, DeleteTopics, CreatePartitions).
Opaque consumer group metadata object used to bind offsets to a transaction when producing with transactions.

Opaque rich error object carrying code, name, string, and flags (retriable, fatal, txn_requires_abort). Create with rd_kafka_error_new() or returned from many APIs; free with rd_kafka_error_destroy().
Opaque message headers list container. Create with rd_kafka_headers_new(), manipulate with header APIs, attach to messages or extract from consumed messages.
Opaque per-group operation result container used by Admin APIs operating on groups and offsets.
Opaque per-ACL operation result container used by ACL Admin APIs.
Opaque UUID type used by newer Admin/Describe APIs. Create, copy, destroy via provided functions and access base64 or MSB/LSB parts.
Opaque per-topic-partition Admin API result encapsulating a TopicPartition along with an rd_kafka_error_t.
Enumeration of all librdkafka error codes, including negative local errors and non-negative broker error codes. Used widely as return/status codes.
Struct describing an error: numeric code, symbolic name, and human-readable description. Used with rd_kafka_get_err_descs().
Concrete descriptor for a Topic+Partition plus optional offset, metadata, opaque, and per-entry error. Used in offset APIs, rebalancing, Admin DeleteRecords, etc.
Growable list of rd_kafka_topic_partition_t elements. Create with rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_new(), add/find/sort, and destroy with rd_kafka_topic_partition_list_destroy().

objects.description: Enumeration of var-arg tags used by rd_kafka_producev()/rd_kafka_produceva() to identify subsequent arguments’ types.
Container element for the typed-argument array variant of produce (rd_kafka_produceva). Each entry identifies a field and its value.
Concrete message object used for both produced delivery reports and consumed messages. Contains topic, partition, payload, key, offset, and error.
Enumeration describing persistence of a produced message (never sent/failed, possibly persisted, fully persisted).
Result code for configuration set/get operations (unknown name, invalid value, or OK).
SSL certificate type selector for rd_kafka_conf_set_ssl_cert().
SSL certificate encoding selector for rd_kafka_conf_set_ssl_cert().
Opaque node (broker) object used by Describe APIs to expose id/host/port/rack for cluster members.
Concrete description of a consumer group member, used in legacy rd_kafka_list_groups() results. Contains ids, host, and raw metadata/assignment blobs.
Enumeration of consumer group states for Admin/List or DescribeConsumerGroups. Also used for filtering.
Enumeration classifying consumer group type (consumer or classic). Used in Admin filters and Describe results.
Concrete legacy group description used by rd_kafka_list_groups(). Contains broker, group, state strings, protocol info and members array.
Container for a list of rd_kafka_group_info returned by rd_kafka_list_groups(). Must be freed with rd_kafka_group_list_destroy().
Concrete broker entry inside rd_kafka_metadata_t (id, host, port).
Concrete partition description inside metadata, with leader, replicas, ISR, and per-partition error.
Concrete topic description inside metadata, includes partitions array and per-topic error.
Top-level metadata result struct returned by rd_kafka_metadata(). Must be freed with rd_kafka_metadata_destroy().
Integer type for event bitmasks and identifiers used with the Event interface.
Opaque container for Admin API per-call options (timeouts, validate_only, broker routing, etc.). Create with rd_kafka_AdminOptions_new(); destroy with rd_kafka_AdminOptions_destroy().
Isolation level used by certain Admin APIs (e.g., ListOffsets).

objects.description: Enumeration identifying Admin API operation kinds. Used when creating AdminOptions to enforce option validity.
Opaque descriptor for a topic to be created with CreateTopics. Populate partitions/replication or explicit replica assignments and configs.
Opaque descriptor of a topic to delete via DeleteTopics.
Opaque descriptor to increase a topic’s partition count via CreatePartitions, with optional replica assignments for new partitions.
Opaque configuration entry used in DescribeConfigs results; exposes name/value, source, sensitivity, synonyms, etc.
Opaque resource descriptor for Alter/Describe configs: identifies resource type/name and holds entries to set incrementally or fully.
Enumeration of configuration entry sources returned by DescribeConfigs.
Enumeration of resource types used for Admin Config operations and ACLs.
Enumeration describing how a resource name should be matched (literal, prefixed, match, any).
Enumeration of incremental alter config operation types (set, delete, append, subtract).
Opaque descriptor for DeleteRecords Admin API containing before-offsets per partition.
Opaque collection of topics used for DescribeTopics Admin API requests.
Opaque partition information element in DescribeTopics results (id, leader node, replicas, ISR).
Opaque topic description in DescribeTopics results, including name, id (Uuid), partitions, internal flag, error and authorized ops.
Opaque per-group listing entry returned by ListConsumerGroups (id, flags, state, type).
Opaque container of ListConsumerGroups results (valid groups and per-broker errors).
Opaque detailed description of a consumer group returned by DescribeConsumerGroups (members, coordinator, assignments, ops).
Opaque member description within a ConsumerGroupDescription (ids, host, assignment and target assignment).
Opaque member assignment payload for a member in DescribeConsumerGroups.
Opaque descriptor of a consumer group to delete via DeleteGroups.
Opaque descriptor of a ListConsumerGroupOffsets request for a group with a set of partitions.
Opaque descriptor of an AlterConsumerGroupOffsets request for a group with partitions and desired offsets.
Opaque descriptor of a DeleteConsumerGroupOffsets request for a group with partitions to clear offsets.
Selector for ListOffsets defining which offset to request (earliest, latest, max timestamp) or a timestamp if non-negative is provided in topic_partition.offset.
Opaque element in ListOffsets result containing the topic partition and the matched offset timestamp.
Enumeration of SCRAM mechanisms for user credentials Admin API.
Opaque descriptor containing mechanism and iterations for a user’s SCRAM credential.
Opaque description of a user’s SCRAM credentials (mechanisms, iterations) or an error per user. Returned by DescribeUserScramCredentials.
Opaque descriptor for altering (upserting or deleting) a user’s SCRAM credentials via Admin API.
Opaque per-user response entry returned by AlterUserScramCredentials (contains user and error).
